description: Landfill Site Selection Suitability Map of Turkiye is a data set deposited in Figshare by its authors Muhammed Oguzhan Mete, Muhammed Yahya Biyik. This is a raster-based suitability map of landfill sites produced after the February 6, 2023, Türkiye earthquakes centred on Kahramanmaraş - Pazarcık and Kahramanmaraş - Elbistan. Coverage: national (TR); the metadata date the deposit to 2024. The formats are not stated in the metadata. Size stated: 447906361 Bytes. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support emergency-service and public-facility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-figshare-repository.
